subject.title: Dashboard: full-bleed tab layout + "tab app" bundle

question: Should OpenClaw accept full-bleed tab-app layout as bundled dashboard work after the modular-dashboard base lands, or require the tab-app bundle pattern to prove out externally first?
rationale: The request is plausible Control UI ergonomics work, but it changes a default-facing dashboard surface and depends on security-sensitive custom-widget behavior that automation cannot product-approve.

options.title: Keep As Gated Wave 2 Work
options.body: Keep this issue open as the focused full-bleed/tab-app follow-up and require the base dashboard PRs plus sandbox/storage decisions to settle before implementation.

options.title: Prove Externally First
options.body: Ask for the tab-app bundle convention to live as an external plugin or ClawHub package until maintainers identify a missing generic seam.

options.title: Defer Dashboard Apps Layer
options.body: Pause this apps-layer direction if maintainers do not want bundled dashboard app surfaces in the current product cycle.

recommendation.title: Keep As Gated Wave 2 Work
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the focused full-bleed/tab-app follow-up and require the base dashboard PRs plus sandbox/storage decisions to settle before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the strongest recent history signal for the Control UI plugin-tab seam and appears in the merged Logbook precedent this issue builds on.
